dialogues.speaker: Dorokhov
dialogues.text: Haha... it's all stories, none of it's real, none of it...

dialogues.speaker: Dorokhov
dialogues.text: Eek! Y-You startled me! Oh, you nearly scared me to death...

dialogues.speaker: Dorokhov
dialogues.text: Uh... I'm fine. I just got... scared by Khrustalev's stories...

dialogues.speaker: Dorokhov
dialogues.text: Do you know Khrustalev? He's the one over there who keeps muttering about ghost stories. I chat with him now and then, and sometimes he reads me the stories he's written...

dialogues.speaker: Dorokhov
dialogues.text: He... He reads them so casually, and he keeps saying those stories are boring and unoriginal, but...

dialogues.speaker: Dorokhov
dialogues.text: But... But I really have run into things I can't explain! Like pots and bowls suddenly clattering in the kitchen in the middle of the night, scratching sounds coming from outside the window, and backward footprints appearing outside the door...

dialogues.speaker: Dorokhov
dialogues.text: I'm about to lose my mind! All I can do is tell myself it was probably just a simple attempted crime... Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Dorokhov
dialogues.text: If someone is trying to commit a crime, at least I can report it to the authorities. But if it's...

dialogues.speaker: Dorokhov
dialogues.text: Never mind. It's not real, it's not real...
